test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 3: Student Interacts with the Course
test_cases.test_case_title: Student Logs into System for Course Exploration
test_cases.pre_condition: A new student account 'student_newuser@example.com' exists and is enrolled in the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course. The student is currently logged out and on the Landing Page. The 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course has sessions and files set up. The student has previously logged out.
test_cases.expected_result: The user is authenticated, their session is initiated, and they are redirected to the Dashboard Page, where they can see the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course listed.
test_cases.post_condition: The student 'student_newuser@example.com' is successfully logged into the system and is on the Dashboard Page, with an active session.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Login' button in the navbar to open the login modal.
